# HELD: the tag block exists only inside a code fence

```md
- type: Pattern
- domain: legal case management
- user: solo-practitioner lawyer
- platform: desktop
- problem: quoting the contract instead of meeting it
- confidence: medium
- outcome: unknown
- source: fixture — adversarial pass, library lint
```

## Principle

Prose that carries a transferable reason and runs comfortably past the minimum word count the
gate requires, so this fixture fails on its tags and never on its sections.

## Do not copy

More real prose past the minimum word count, for the same reason — an ambiguous fixture proves
nothing about the rule it was written to pin.
